currentFacts: OpenPet is an Electron desktop pet platform with a React Control Center
PetService is the single source of truth for pet state
Control Center owns user-facing configuration
API keys and provider credentials stay in the main process
Local HTTP and MCP are loopback-only and disabled by default

macOS whole-computer custom cursor scope is backed by a native click-through helper; system scope persists only after activation succeeds, and helper failure or app shutdown restores the native pointer while Windows and Linux remain unsupported
Bundled pets include doro, duodong, and chispa
Codex pet directory import and zip import are supported
Common provider presets such as OpenRouter and Together remain endpoint templates rather than verified integrations; only the OpenPet 8317 gateway preset is tied to archived smoke evidence
Chat provider settings separate active saved config from renderer drafts, support separate save and test connection actions, and avoid the older coupled connection-check workflow
Image generation settings use one OpenAI-compatible image Provider contract with unified OpenAI-compatible provider settings rather than the older split fixture-versus-provider selector model

Creator Studio Pet character generation is governed by docs/pet-character-generation.md: one clean user source, exactly one image attachment per Provider request, local composite reference boards, and a QA-gated running-right to running-left approved-mirror correction; running-left is derived locally without a separate Provider request
Creator Studio real generated atlas QA is landed through source-image-validation.json and atlas-validation.json artifacts before full-pet import approval
Trigger Proposal Inbox is the host review path for Creator Studio trigger proposals and imported follow-up review
Real-provider smoke entrypoints exist for AI provider verification, Bubble Chat acceptance, and Creator Studio provider-path validation

AI provider smoke evidence is archived under docs/release-evidence/ai-provider-smoke/2026-06-28T11-08-10Z-openpet-gateway/ where gpt-5.5 passed chat smoke, gpt-image-2 was discoverable, and image generation remained intentionally opt-in and was skipped

Creator Studio provider smoke evidence is archived under docs/release-evidence/creator-studio-provider-smoke/2026-06-28T14-06-27-403Z/ where a gpt-image-2 request completed in about 265s under a 420000ms timeout override and was explicitly treated as provider-path validation, not production asset-quality approval

AI Talk Bubble Chat smoke evidence is archived under docs/release-evidence/ai-talk-local-smoke/2026-06-28T15-35-59-210Z/ and the run-ai-talk-local-smoke entrypoint records bubbleAcceptance requestId, providerLatencyMs, bubbleDispatch.petSayReceived, bubbleDispatch.bubbleStateVisible, and a manualAcceptanceTemplate placeholder

The archived AI Talk Bubble Chat smoke proves providerLatencyMs was 2141, bubbleDispatch.petSayReceived was true, and bubbleDispatch.bubbleStateVisible was true, but it does not by itself prove transparent popup placement or full human acceptance

Creator Workflow host smoke evidence is archived under docs/release-evidence/creator-workflow-host-smoke/2026-07-04T21-38-29-834Z-dev8-acceptance/ and docs/release-evidence/creator-workflow-host-smoke/2026-07-04T21-56-30-104Z-main-acceptance/ where the narrowed one-click new-pet and existing-action chain both completed through /images/edits with one redacted front-image reference on codex/dev8 and on a clean main acceptance worktree

Bundled agent-awareness ships as openpet.agent-awareness, stays enabled by default but stopped until an explicit user start, and keeps native execution approval as the boundary before the service can run
The reserved agent-awareness health-note summary contract is X active · Y sessions · Z events

Agent-awareness real-session smoke keeps run-agent-awareness-local-smoke and its manualAcceptanceTemplate boundary tied to docs/release-evidence/agent-awareness-local-smoke/2026-07-03T16-04-08-824Z/ where unknownRecordCount 0 and unsupportedLifecycleRecordCount 0 were preserved for later human review

Agent-awareness archived telemetry hashes session ids, reduces project paths to basename plus short hash, reconciles hook plus polling signals into one bounded runtime session model, and keeps the bundled operator command surface centered on doctor/codex-hook-plan/install-codex-hooks/uninstall-codex-hooks for auditable local workflows

AI provider smoke report contracts and Creator Studio provider smoke report contracts are part of the current TypeScript migration baseline
The typed plugin view config schema/storage/signature payloads, action-frame inspectionResult payloads, and pet-pack mutation view payloads are normalized at the main-process adapter boundary
The shared TypeScript contract now models discriminated random/state/event trigger-rule spec contracts as a discriminated random/state/event union
Local extensions support explicit setup, command, dashboard, and service controls with conservative security wording

The current plugin host bridge permission boundary includes trigger-proposals:write for Creator Studio handoff review and model:image-generate for host-managed generation; plugin-managed provider credentials are unsupported for host-managed generation
